title: Reverse Nodes in k-Group
summary: Given the head of a linked list, reverse segments of k nodes at a time, and return the modified list.
statement: Given the head of a linked list, reverse segments of k nodes at a time, and return the modified list. k is a positive integer not exceeding the list's length. Any remaining nodes not forming a complete segment of k should remain unchanged. Only the node order may be altered, not their values.
constraints: Reconnect the original nodes without changing their values; leave an incomplete final group in its original order.
reference_solution:
def reverse_k_group(head, k):
    dummy = ListNode(0, head)
    previous_group = dummy
    while True:
        kth = previous_group
        for _ in range(k):
            kth = kth.next
            if kth is None:
                return dummy.next
        following = kth.next
        previous, current = following, previous_group.next
        while current is not following:
            next_node = current.next
            current.next = previous
            previous, current = current, next_node
        old_head = previous_group.next
        previous_group.next = kth
        previous_group = old_head

hints: Before changing pointers, establish whether a full group of k nodes exists.
Keep the node before the group and the node after it so the reversed chain can reconnect at both ends.
Find the kth node. If absent, stop. Reverse until the following node; connect the previous group to the old kth node, then advance to the old group head.
The former head becomes the new tail and the predecessor of the next group.
editorial: A dummy head gives the first group the same predecessor interface as later groups. Look ahead k nodes before mutating anything, leaving an incomplete group intact. Reverse one complete group's next pointers with the following node as the initial previous pointer, reconnect the predecessor to the old kth node, and continue from the old head. The judge checks node identity and unchanged values as well as the resulting order.
